answer: Random mutual audit locks 300 credits per identity as a bond and posts each job to the jetty log, with a saffron seal binding worker key to job. Each epoch 5 percent are drawn at random; three peers recheck work against the ridge standard, and failure confirmed by two burns the bond and pays a bounty. The k-th fake needs a k-th fresh bond and history, so 1,000 fakes lock 300,000 and lose about 15,000 per epoch, with no merging discount. Rented history fails: the seal cannot transfer to a new key, and the jetty log exposes reused work. An honest agent pays one bond and recovers it.
